subject: Eval kickoff: Redwood + Acme - scheduling & success criteria
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acme.com>, Emily Park <emily.park@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & eval kickoff - Redwood + Acme

Hi Sanjay / Emily,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier - great conversation. Quick recap from our discovery call and suggested next steps so we can get the evaluation kickstarted: 

Recap:
- Primary need: sub-second-ish inference for customer-facing recommendations + controllable cost profile.
- Key constraints: must stay within Acme's VPC for data flows (security), and prefer GPU-backed instances for latency.
- Success metrics discussed: 95th percentile latency < 300ms on 2k qps simulated traffic; token cost target <$0.0008/token; qualitative parity on top-3 prompt families.

Proposal: schedule an evaluation kickoff (trial plan + success criteria + prompt set review + technical deep dive) to align attendees and timelines. I propose we do a 60-75 minute kickoff to cover both product/POC scope and infra requirements.

Suggested slots (PT):
- Tue, Sep 8 - 10:00-11:15 AM PT
- Wed, Sep 9 - 1:00-2:15 PM PT

Please let me know which slot works, and whether your infra/security and ML engineer (who will run the eval) can join. Attendees on our side will be myself (sales), Marissa Cole (customer success), and Connor Obrien (solutions engineer) who will lead the technical deep dive and help shape the prompt/eval plan.

Attached: acme-eval-plan-v1.pdf (high-level trial plan) and a calendar invite stub (redwood-poc-schedule.ics).

If OK, I'll lock the calendar and send the kickoff agenda.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acme.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & eval kickoff - Redwood + Acme

Thanks Rishi - appreciate the summary. 

High level: Sep 8 or Sep 9 both look promising, but our infra lead (Priya) is only available on Sep 8 in the morning. We definitely want the technical deep dive during the kickoff - she'll need to validate VPC/networking and KMS integration.

A couple quick clarifications before we lock time: 
- For success metrics, can you confirm how you measure token cost in the eval? Is that including model caching and burst behavior?
- For the prompt set, we have three families (recommendations, summarization of user sessions, admin automation). Would you want a subset ahead of time to instrument?

If Sep 8 10:00-11:15 AM PT works for you and your SEs, lock it and we'll make sure Priya and our ML engineer (Emily) are on the invite.

Best,
Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme Corp

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & eval kickoff - Redwood + Acme

Hi Sanjay - thanks for the quick reply and helpful notes. Sep 8 10:00 AM PT works for us - locking that in.

Quick answers to your clarifying questions:
- Token cost: our eval reporting includes per-token execution cost with caching and batching enabled where appropriate. The acme-eval-plan-v1.pdf includes expected cost profile estimates for three workload shapes (low/med/high concurrency) and shows the impact of prefix/KV caching. We'll instrument the trial with the same accounting to keep apples-to-apples.
- Prompt set: yes - please send a representative subset (2-3 prompts per family) ahead of the kickoff. Connor will pre-load them into the eval harness and Marissa will work with you on scoring criteria.

Proposed kickoff agenda (60-75m):
1) Introductions & goals (10m) - Rishi/Marissa + Acme leaders
2) Trial plan & success criteria (15m) - go over acme-eval-plan-v1.pdf
3) Prompt set review & prep (15m) - pick the initial prompt subset and scoring rubric
4) Technical deep dive (20m) - Connor to cover VPC, auth, and runtime/latency knobs
5) Next steps & owners (5m)

Attendees from our side: Rishi (sales), Marissa (CS lead), Connor (SE).

I'll send the calendar invite with the agenda and attach the eval plan again. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
Rishi
